name: TWZRD Preflight
description: Trust gate on twzrd-x402-gate 0.13.0: wrapFetchWithTwzrdPreflight on HTTP 402 plus payment-shaped tool-call hooks. Defaults: enforce, fail-closed; wash flagged or unknown, an uncapped warn and an unevaluated seller refuse. Shadow/fail-open/each opt-out are opt-in.

mode.description: off = disabled; shadow = evaluate + log would-blocks, never block (opt-in); enforce = block on every refusal rule below.

failMode.description: Behavior when the trust API is unreachable: closed = block (default); open = allow (opt-in).

refuseWashFlagged.description: Refuse payTo when free merchant_card.wash_flagged is true. Opt out with false.

refuseWashUnknown.description: Tool-call hook: refuse a payTo whose merchant_card does not show full, fresh wash coverage (wash_flagged not a boolean, wash_stale, ring_evaluated false, confidence other than full, or no card). Read only while refuseWashFlagged is on. wrapFetchWithTwzrdPreflight takes the same option; unset, it follows twzrd-x402-gate 0.13.0 (TWZRD_REFUSE_WASH_UNKNOWN, else on). Opt out with false.

refuseUncappedWarn.description: Tool-call hook: refuse a warn whose readiness card has no recommended_cap_usdc, or a call that names no price to hold to it. Opt out with false.

refuseUnevaluated.description: Tool-call hook: refuse a seller intel has never evaluated (null_reason set, or score null). false pays it within the card's recommended_cap_usdc at a known price.

refuseUnparsedPayments.description: Refuse a payment-shaped tool call whose payee cannot be read: an exec curl/wget sending a signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE or X-PAYMENT header with no seller wallet and no observed 402 payTo for its origin, or a payment-named tool (agentcash or x402 in the name, or pay/payment as a whole word) whose URL is not in an origin or url param. Opt out with false.

timeoutMs.description: Preflight HTTP timeout in ms. On timeout, failMode applies.

maxPriceUsdc.description: Local price ceiling in USDC. Payment calls above this are blocked (enforce) or logged (shadow) without calling the API.

denyWallets.description: Local denylist of seller wallet addresses. Always blocked in enforce mode, no API call.

allowWallets.description: Local allowlist of seller wallet addresses. Always allowed, no API call.

cacheTtlMs.description: TTL in ms for per-seller decision cache and 402 payTo origin cache.

matchers.description: Extra tool matchers extending coverage beyond the built-in AgentCash + exec rails. Matched in order; first match wins.

tool.description: Tool name or substring to match (case-insensitive).

walletParam.description: Param key whose value is the seller wallet (base58 Solana pubkey).

urlParam.description: Param key whose value is a URL; origin used as preflight resource_url.

priceParam.description: Param key for payment amount in USDC.

resourceParam.description: Param key for a human-readable resource name.
